verdict.rationale: Otter explicitly documents desktop-based, bot-free recording/transcription ("Record conversations directly from your Mac or Windows desktop, without bots joining the call" and "Capture impromptu Google Meet calls without a bot present"), directly matching the story. However, all supporting evidence is vendor-authored; community discussion in the pack focuses entirely on the bot-based joining experience (visible bot, default sharing, privacy issues) rather than validating the bot-free desktop-capture mode, so there is no independent hands-on confirmation this mode works as claimed. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation that bot-free desktop capture actually works and is undetectable to other participants, and detail on what info (if any) is disclosed to other call participants in this mode.
